sections.text_helper: Section 43.4.20 "Hardware trigger generation" in chapter 43 (LCD-TFT display controller (LTDC)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2114.
sections.section_content:
The LTDC can generate an hardware trigger on a line event to synchronize with other
peripherals.
As these hardware events reuse the interrupt circuitry, the enable bit must be set in order
toproperly generate the hardware event. The interrupt masking must thus be done
atNVIClevel.
[Table 385. LTDC hardware triggers]
